name: agentmemory

tagline_zh: 基于真实基准测试的 #1 持久记忆方案。Agent 重启、上下文爆掉、跨会话，它都记得你改过哪行代码、为什么改。
tagline_en: The #1 persistent memory for coding agents, benchmarked on real-world tasks. Survives restarts, context.
desc_en: #1 Persistent memory for AI coding agents based on real-world benchmarks
why_zh: 别家靠向量库硬塞，它按真实编码基准设计记忆结构，知道哪些该存、哪些该忘，召回准得不像缓存。
why_en: Others stuff vectors; it structures memory around real coding benchmarks, knowing what to keep or drop—recall sharp enough to.
limit_zh: 只服务 AI 编码 Agent（如 Claude Code），不接普通聊天机器人；需 Python 3.9+ 且能联网。
limit_en: For AI coding agents only (e.g., Claude Code), not general chatbots; needs Python 3.9+ and network for deps; memory doesn't transfer across agent.
